The mountain of the house of the Lord is something, it seems, that God himself would establish in the mountains. When I entered this Territory in August last, on my return from my last mission, I beheld…

Such was the land held in reserve from the dominion of the image, and destined to give rise to the kingdom of the “ stone/’ Such the holy mountain where God’s purposes lay concealed, and from whence they were to originate in the latter day.
